html: II. נוה (√ of foll., meaning dub.; Arabic نَوَى is aim at, propose to oneself as aim (e.g. of journey), viii. betake oneself to a place of alighting, or abode; نَوًى, نِيَّةٌ place to which one purposes journeying Lane 3040; hence poss. i. נָוֶה as goal of shepherd; cf. Sab. נוי meadow, pasture, DHMSüdar. Alt. 32; see however Dr 1 S 19:18 HPS ib.; NH נָוָה dwelling, habitation).
